**Best move:** Nxe3

**Main line:** Nxe3 Qxf7+ Kxf7 Rd7+ Rxd7 (Black is up a rook and pawn, completely winning)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note (80 words max):**
Your knight on d5 can jump to e3 and fork the queen and rook—the two pieces White has left that matter. Yes, White checks with Qxf7+, but you have time. After Kxf7, you've won the queen for a pawn. When White tries Rd7+ to create threats, you simply take with Rxd7 and you're up a full rook. Before moving, always scan if your pieces can hit two enemy pieces at once—that's often where the killer blow hides.
